rules: Do not populate any supervised split from reference-only samples.
All frames, panels, crops, serial observations, and near-duplicates from one sourceGroupId stay in the same split.
All observations from the same plant or clone-linked capture group stay in the same split when identifiers are available.
Cross-crop transfer datasets are excluded from Cannabis ground-truth splits.
Laboratory-dependent labels require the corresponding confirmation evidence before eligibility.
A split is not publishable until duplicate/perceptual-hash and provenance audits pass.

plannedRatiosAfterUnlock.assignmentUnit: sourceGroupId first; plant/capture group second; never individual panel/frame when related observations exist
